SELECT tm.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, tm.shop_id AS shopId, CASE WHEN tm.shop_id = 0 THEN t.tenant_name ELSE s.shop_name END AS shopName, tm.id AS memberId, tm.member_type AS memberType, NULL AS platformMemberId, CASE WHEN tm.shop_id = 0 THEN 'TENANT' ELSE 'SHOP' END AS workspaceType FROM tenant_member tm INNER JOIN tenant t ON t.id = tm.tenant_id LEFT JOIN shop s ON s.id = tm.shop_id AND s.tenant_id = tm.tenant_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.status = 1 AND tm.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status = 1 AND (t.expires_at IS NULL OR t.expires_at > NOW(3)) AND (tm.shop_id = 0 OR s.status = 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 AS tenantId, '平台管理' AS tenantName, 0 AS shopId, NULL AS shopName, NULL AS memberId, NULL AS memberType, pm.id AS platformMemberId, 'PLATFORM' AS workspaceType FROM platform_member pm WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.status = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM platform_member_role pmr INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = pmr.role_id WHERE pmr.platform_member_id = pm.id AND r.tenant_id = 0 AND r.scope_type = 0 AND r.status = 1 )
ORDER BY tenantId, shopId

SELECT 'TENANT' AS workspaceType, tm.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, t.status AS tenantStatus, t.expires_at AS tenantExpiresAt, tm.shop_id AS shopId, NULL AS shopName, NULL AS shopStatus, tm.id AS memberId, tm.member_type AS memberType, tm.status AS memberStatus, tm.deleted_at AS memberDeletedAt, NULL AS platformMemberId, NULL AS platformMemberStatus, NULL AS platformRoleCount FROM tenant_member tm INNER JOIN tenant t ON t.id = tm.tenant_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tm.shop_id = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT 'SHOP' AS workspaceType, tm.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, t.status AS tenantStatus, t.expires_at AS tenantExpiresAt, tm.shop_id AS shopId, s.shop_name AS shopName, s.status AS shopStatus, tm.id AS memberId, tm.member_type AS memberType, tm.status AS memberStatus, tm.deleted_at AS memberDeletedAt, NULL AS platformMemberId, NULL AS platformMemberStatus, NULL AS platformRoleCount FROM tenant_member tm INNER JOIN tenant t ON t.id = tm.tenant_id INNER JOIN shop s ON s.id = tm.shop_id AND s.tenant_id = tm.tenant_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tm.shop_id = #{shopId} LIMIT 1

SELECT 'PLATFORM' AS workspaceType, 0 AS tenantId, '平台管理' AS tenantName, NULL AS tenantStatus, NULL AS tenantExpiresAt, 0 AS shopId, NULL AS shopName, NULL AS shopStatus, NULL AS memberId, NULL AS memberType, NULL AS memberStatus, NULL AS memberDeletedAt, pm.id AS platformMemberId, pm.status AS platformMemberStatus, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM platform_member_role pmr INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = pmr.role_id WHERE pmr.platform_member_id = pm.id AND r.tenant_id = 0 AND r.scope_type = 0 AND r.status = 1 ) AS platformRoleCount FROM platform_member pm WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
